title: Shared shapes of the CLI state files

ProcessKey.description: a harness process key, pid:<pid>:<start>, the start as ps -o lstart= prints it in the C locale with spaces as -

Handle.description: an agent handle; user, me and relay are reserved

ShortId.description: a Claude Code background session's short id

LaunchSession.description: a harness session id as spawn and launch files carry it

Argv.description: a command's words, run without a shell

Words.description: a command's words, which may be empty strings

Seconds.description: seconds as a number, a numeric string, a duration such as 10m or 2h, or Infinity
